result.summary: Several visual/content bugs: a raw localization key is shown as a section title, restaurant names and category chips are clipped, and the last promo card is cut off at the bottom.

issues.description: The popular section heading displays the untranslated localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the localized string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and add a fallback so missing translations never render the key.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card is clipped on the right so the restaurant name ('Trattoria Piccol...') and image are cut off.
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal carousel enough padding/peek, or shrink card width so full names and images stay on-screen.

issues.description: The last restaurant promo card is cut off at the bottom by the tab bar, hiding most of the restaurant details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so cards can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The last category chip ('Healthy') is partially cut off at the right edge of the filter row.
issues.suggestion: Allow the chip row to scroll horizontally with end padding so the last chip is fully visible.
